summary: Gas is gone and headquarters is full of Titans. Armin's small plan clears the depot. Outside, the rogue Titan falls, and a human body is in the nape.

segments.ja: ミカサとアルミンは、補給本部の屋根まで届きます。届いた建物の中は、安全ではありません。ではありません。ガスを求める兵が、すでに中庭と倉庫に閉じ込められています。閉じ込められた中に、ジャン、コニー、そしてマルコの姿があります。ある姿は、飛べない人間の姿です。飛べない理由は、筒が空だからです。空の筒のまま外へ出れば、巨人の手の高さで終わります。終わる前に、彼らは扉の内側で息を整えます。
segments.en: Mikasa and Armin reach the roof of the supply headquarters. The inside of the building they reached is not safe. It is not. Soldiers who need gas are already trapped in the courtyard and the depot. Among the trapped are the figures of Jean, Connie, and Marco. The figures that are there are figures of humans who cannot fly. The reason they cannot fly is that the cylinders are empty. If they go outside with empty cylinders, they end at the height of a Titan's hand. Before they end, they steady their breath inside the door.

segments.en: Small Titans have entered the room where the gas barrels are. The number that have entered is not large. In place of a large number, they completely block the width of the room. The mouths that block are waiting for the soldiers visible from the window. In the state of waiting, nobody can touch a barrel. As long as they cannot touch one, the ODM gear is decoration. Jean looks at the decorative blades with anger. The anger he looks with does not yet have a correct direction.

segments.en: Armin draws a simple diagram on the floor. The diagram he draws is not a hero's charge. It is not. It is: gather the Titans' attention to one window, and in that interval drop blades from a hole in the ceiling. The blades that drop are small. The reason they are small is that they aim only at one point on the nape. To aim, someone has to accept danger in a visible position. He does not yet say that necessary role under his own name. Mikasa understands the diagram he does not say, first.

segments.en: The dangerous side of the plan is to show a human figure in front of the window. Several people take the role of showing it, with guns and voices. The sound they take turns the Titans' faces in one direction. The nape of the back that turned becomes bare from the ceiling side. The squad above waits for the one point that became bare. The time of waiting is a few seconds. During the few seconds, the humans below cannot run. Not being able to run is the price of the small blade.

segments.en: At the same moment as the signal, the soldiers above drop through the hole. The blades that drop are not the long slashes of training. They are not. They only cut a shallow line on the nape, shortly. If the depth of the cut is enough, the Titan collapses inside the room. Armin counts the order of collapsing according to the diagram. segments.en: Jean, with the gas returned, is the first to check the air outside. The way of flying he checks differs from last night's hope of safety. segments.en: After filling the cylinder, Mikasa immediately searches for the position of the abnormal Titan. The reason she searches is that the body is on the last street where Eren was. The body that is there, after bringing down many other Titans, is dropping in movement. The steam of the drop begins to cover the surface of the muscle. The figure that begins to be covered is not a pose of victory. It is not. It resembles a soldier whose fuel has run out. She does not yet put the resemblance into her mouth. Without putting it, she holds a blade at the edge of the roof. The blade she holds is no longer the blade of the small plan.

segments.en: Inside the split nape there is a human upper body. The face of the upper body that is there is not yet fixed, because of blood and steam. segments.en: Today's victory is not a story of one person slashing Titans alone. It is not. It is a story of gathering attention, making a few seconds, and dropping a short blade onto the exact position. The squad that dropped it got the gas back. It is: gather the Titans' attention to one window, and in that interval drop blades from a hole in the ceiling. The blades that drop are small. The reason they are small is that they aim only at one point on the nape. To aim, someone has to accept danger in a visible position. He does not yet say that necessary role under his own name. Mikasa understands the diagram he does not say, first.

vocab.exampleJa: 近づく足は、計画の足ではなく、友の足です。
vocab.exampleEn: Inside the split nape there is a human upper body. The face of the upper body that is there is not yet fixed, because of blood and steam. Without being fixed, the color of the hair and the one remaining arm call someone's memory. Armin approaches the memory they call without putting it into a voice. The feet that approach are not the feet of the plan. They are a friend's feet. He does not yet say the friend's name. The reason he does not say it is that if he is wrong after saying it fully, it becomes a second death.

vocab.exampleJa: 崩れることを、彼女はマフラーの下で抑えます。
vocab.exampleEn: Mikasa does not come down from the roof toward the person in the nape. The reason she does not come down is that if she calls the name before confirmation, she herself collapses. She holds down the collapsing under the scarf. While she holds it down, Armin enters the steam first. She protects the back that enters from the position of first place. The blade that protects refuses the approach of other Titans. The role of refusing is her limit today. Beyond the limit, the color of the hair begins to look like Eren's color.

vocab.exampleJa: 大きい音のあと、立体機動は再び翼になります。
vocab.exampleEn: When the last Titan falls, the room fills with blood and steam. Soldiers run across the filled floor to the barrels. The hands that run put gas back into the cylinders. The sound of putting it back is the loudest sound inside headquarters. After the loud sound, the ODM gear becomes wings again. With the wings it becomes, they look at the street outside. There are still Titans in the street they look at. Many of the Titans that are there are fighting one abnormal body. The scene of fighting does not complete the success of the resupply. It does not.

vocab.exampleJa: 向いた背中のうなじが、天井側から裸になります。
vocab.exampleEn: The dangerous side of the plan is to show a human figure in front of the window. Several people take the role of showing it, with guns and voices. The sound they take turns the Titans' faces in one direction. The nape of the back that turned becomes bare from the ceiling side. The squad above waits for the one point that became bare. The time of waiting is a few seconds. During the few seconds, the humans below cannot run. Not being able to run is the price of the small blade.

vocab.exampleJa: 震えても、順番は乱れません。
vocab.exampleEn: At the same moment as the signal, the soldiers above drop through the hole. The blades that drop are not the long slashes of training. They are not. They only cut a shallow line on the nape, shortly. If the depth of the cut is enough, the Titan collapses inside the room. Armin counts the order of collapsing according to the diagram. The voice that counts is shaking. Even shaking, the order does not break. Not breaking is his way of fighting. The way of fighting is a different kind from Eren's anger.

vocab.exampleJa: 触れない限り、立体機動は飾りです。
vocab.exampleEn: Small Titans have entered the room where the gas barrels are. The number that have entered is not large. In place of a large number, they completely block the width of the room. The mouths that block are waiting for the soldiers visible from the window. In the state of waiting, nobody can touch a barrel. As long as they cannot touch one, the ODM gear is decoration. Jean looks at the decorative blades with anger. The anger he looks with does not yet have a correct direction.

vocab.exampleJa: 今日の勝利は、巨人を一人で斬った話ではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: Today's victory is not a story of one person slashing Titans alone. It is not. It is a story of gathering attention, making a few seconds, and dropping a short blade onto the exact position. The squad that dropped it got the gas back. After getting it back, they touch a larger mystery. The mystery they touch is that an ally's face may be coming out of an enemy's nape. At the stage of may, Armin closes the plan once. The face that closes it is still the face that drew the diagram.
